title: Asymptotic theory of rerandomization for survival analysis
summary: Rerandomization systematically reduces chance imbalance and can improve the efficiency of the average treatment effect estimator in randomized experiments. While the asymptotic properties of finite-dimensional M-estimators under rerandomization have been established, existing theory does not directly address survival outcomes under censoring, where the target estimand involves infinite-dimensional functional parameters.
